notes.dao_folk: Optional merge with chinese_imperial on these plates — same fill.
notes.manichaean: Hatch / minority only from about 200 CE. Never a majority wash.
notes.christian: Dots (1–100), urban hatch (200–300), expanding fill (400–600). No Islam id on 500/600.
notes.islam: Public fill from 700 (Umayyad belt). Color matches the green wash on the 700–1500 plates.
notes.unmapped: Oceania stays gray. Americas are unmapped through 1200; from 1300 they take an indigenous local-traditions fill, not a census.
